info.title: devskim
info.description: DevSkim is a framework and language analyzer that provides inline security analysis. This is a Dotnet Tool package. For the library package, see Microsoft.CST.DevSkim.

options.name: --console-verbosity
options.description: Console verbosity [Verbose|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Fatal] [default: 2]

options.name: --disable-console
options.description: Disable console output of logging messages. [default: False]

options.name: --log-file-level
options.description: Log file level [Verbose|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Fatal] [default: 4]

options.name: --log-file-path
options.description: Log file path. If not set, will not log to file.

options.name: --source-code
options.description: Path to a directory containing files to scan or a single file to scan

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Filename for result file, uses stdout if not set.

options.name: --rules
options.description: Comma separated list of paths to rules files to use [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --rule-ids
options.description: Comma separated list of rule IDs to limit analysis to [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --ignore-rule-ids
options.description: Comma separated list of rule IDs to ignore [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --languages
options.description: Path to custom json formatted Language file to specify languages, when specified comments must also be specified

options.name: --comments
options.description: Path to custom json formatted Comments file to specify languages, when specified languages must also be specified

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Format for output text. [default: %F:%L:%C:%l:%c [%S] %R %N]

options.name: --file-format
options.description: Format type for output. [text|sarif|vs] [default: sarif]

options.name: --severity
options.description: Comma-separated Severities to match [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --confidence
options.description: Comma-separated Severities to match [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --ignore-globs
options.description: Comma-separated Globs for files to skip analyzing [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --include-globs
options.description: If set, files must match one of these globs to be analyzed [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --disable-supression
options.description: Disable comment suppressions [default: False]

options.name: --disable-parallel
options.description: Disable parallel processing [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-default-rules
options.description: Ignore default rules [default: False]

options.name: --crawl-archives
options.description: Analyze files contained inside of archives [default: False]

options.name: --exit-code-is-num-issues
options.description: Use exit code for number of issues. Negative on error. [default: False]

options.name: --base-path
options.description: Specify what path to root result URIs in Sarif results with. When not set will generate paths relative to the source directory (or directory containing the source file specified)

options.name: --absolute-path
options.description: Output absolute paths (overrides --base-path). [default: False]

options.name: --skip-git-ignored-files
options.description: Set to skip files which are ignored by .gitignore. Requires git to be installed. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-excerpts
options.description: Set to skip gathering excerpts and samples to include in the report. [default: False]

options.name: --options-json
options.description: The path to a .json file that contains a serialized SerializedAnalyzeCommandOptions object which can specify both Analyze options and extra options. Options specified explicitly override options from this argument.
